//: Story Phase 13 crew dialogue: the breakdown, the song, the reopened quarters, sash bedding, merchandise, the Channel, the delirium, the apocalypse, the treasure room, the command crisis. Pete is Pete; nobody's identity changes.
pete.p13_crisis_1: pete[tired]: I leaned on it. I LEANED. You lean on things. It's what wheels are FOR.
pete.p13_crisis_2: pete[annoyed]: Every time. Every TIME we get anywhere.
pete.p13_treasure_1: pete[tired]: Brogath's in there. Fine. Brogath's in there. Keep the door shut.
pete.p13_apocalypse_1: pete[tired]: I'll do whatever you say, Captain. I just want you to say it to PETE.
pete.p13_delirium_1: pete[worried]: Captain, it's PETE. Look. Peg leg. Nightcap. Pete.
pete.p13_delirium_2: pete[worried]: I'm not blushing. Am I blushing? I'm blushing because you keep calling me BROGATH.
pete.p13_channel_1: pete[disgusted]: The television smells of onions. I didn't know that was a thing a television could do.
pete.p13_channel_2: pete[annoyed]: It's the story of US, Captain. On a CHANNEL. With a SPONSOR.
pete.p13_merch_1: pete[annoyed]: There's a cardboard man in our bedroom, Captain. He's blushing at me.
pete.p13_merch_2: pete: Round a CANNON. The cable goes round a CANNON.
pete.p13_bedding_1: pete[happy]: (in his sash hammock) I'm not getting up. You can't make me. Well, you can. But I'd rather you didn't.
pete.p13_quarters_1: pete[worried]: My old hammock growled at me, Captain. I slept in that for two years.
pete.p13_quarters_2: pete: It FOLDED it. The storm folded our sheets better than we ever have.
pete.p13_song_1: pete[annoyed]: It's catchy. That's the worst thing about it. It's CATCHY.
pete.p13_breakdown_1: pete: I said no to the tootlet, Captain. I'll say no to all of them. I'm very rested. I've got a lot of no in me.
bob.p13_crisis_1: bob: Is there going to be a DEBATE? Can I watch the debate?
bob.p13_treasure_1: bob[concerned]: I had your belt, Captain. I'm sorry about your belt.
bob.p13_apocalypse_1: bob: Both hands on the rail, Captain! No fingers! I'm VERY legal!
bob.p13_delirium_1: bob[concerned]: Captain? Your Honour? I mean, Captain? I don't know what I'm supposed to call me any more.
bob.p13_delirium_2: bob: (sitting on his hands) I'm not raising anything. Look. Nothing raised.
bob.p13_channel_1: bob[happy]: The BABY one! I like the baby one!
bob.p13_merch_1: bob[happy]: I've got a Bean Bailiff badge! I'm keeping order! Of the beans!
bob.p13_merch_2: bob: I said hello to Sir Rumpus. He didn't say anything. He's cardboard. I still said hello.
bob.p13_bedding_1: bob[happy]: My pillow's got a NOSE on it. Embroidered. I've called it Nosey.
bob.p13_quarters_1: bob[alarmed]: The pillow went MRROW at me. Pillows aren't supposed to have OPINIONS.
bob.p13_song_1: bob: (humming) Don't throw my sash in the trash... sorry. SORRY.
bob.p13_breakdown_1: bob: Is a tootlet a real word, Captain? It sounds like a real word.
gristle.p13_crisis_1: gristle: Good steering, Captain. Real good. Doesn't change who's the captain. You are.
gristle.p13_treasure_1: gristle: I'll hold you back as often as it takes, Captain. That door doesn't open.
gristle.p13_apocalypse_1: gristle: (low) Best-run ship I've ever been on. Maddest captain. Both at once.
gristle.p13_delirium_1: gristle: I'm facing the room, Captain. Like you said. Rear to the... wall.
gristle.p13_delirium_2: gristle[concerned]: He breathed it, Pete. Right off his own beard. Everything that's been in there a month.
gristle.p13_channel_1: gristle: The Disaster's still going, according to the corner. Three hours and counting. I've had shorter watches.
gristle.p13_merch_1: gristle: Not over the rope. Round the rope. Cable never goes over rope. Not on my ship. Your ship.
gristle.p13_bedding_1: gristle[happy]: (lying on a sash pad) Comfortable. Don't tell him I said so.
gristle.p13_quarters_1: gristle: It's not alive, Captain. It's the release in the cloth. I'll say that as many times as anybody needs.
gristle.p13_song_1: gristle: The anchor wouldn't work. I'd have tried the anchor. The song's right about the anchor.
gristle.p13_breakdown_1: gristle: A form. For a toot. Filed in advance. I've heard everything now. I haven't. I will have by tonight.
jim.p13_crisis_1: jim: 'NO FUN.' I'd vote for that. I've had a month of fun.
jim.p13_treasure_1: jim: I had your coat. Sorry about your coat. Again.
jim.p13_apocalypse_1: jim: My sash isn't on, Captain. I've never worn a sash. I've only ever worn an apron.
jim.p13_delirium_1: jim: I'm making my BED, Captain. A bed. I'm a cook making a bed.
jim.p13_delirium_2: jim[annoyed]: He threw my beans out. Again. Lord GUSTAVIO doesn't get beans, apparently.
jim.p13_channel_1: jim[disgusted]: It smells like the PROGRAMME. Onion castle. Cheese cellar. Baby.
jim.p13_merch_2: jim: (pointing at the cable) TRIP HAZARD. NOT A JOKE. I wrote it twice in case.
jim.p13_bedding_1: jim: Toy sashes. Two hundred and ninety of them. Every one of them says AGES SIX AND UP and every one of them is cleaner than anything else we own.
jim.p13_quarters_1: jim[disgusted]: There's no clean cloth on the whole ship. I've checked. I've checked twice.
jim.p13_song_1: jim: It sends it back. The storm sends everything back. That's what we've learned this month: nothing ever goes away.
jim.p13_breakdown_1: jim: (not turning round from the stove) No.
ned.p13_crisis_1: ned: Nine hours to go, Captain. On the suspension. I've still got the crayon lines.
ned.p13_treasure_1: ned: I had your other arm, Captain. Sorry.
ned.p13_apocalypse_1: ned: Real orders, though. Good ones. Just... with bits on the end.
ned.p13_delirium_1: ned[concerned]: Who am I, Captain? Am I anybody? Am I an Ancient one?
ned.p13_channel_1: ned: Castle made of onions. I've been saying that for weeks. Nobody listened.
ned.p13_merch_1: ned: It lowered it down the FORE hatch. On a rope. It knew which hatch. How did it know which HATCH?
ned.p13_bedding_1: ned: Is it safe in there now? It looks like the inside of a jam.
ned.p13_quarters_1: ned: I'm not going in. I'll hold the lantern from the door. I'm a very good door lantern-holder.
ned.p13_song_1: ned: Wax cylinder. Where would you even PLAY a wax cylinder?
ned.p13_breakdown_1: ned: Nineteen hours, Captain. I've drawn nineteen lines on the wall. I cross one off every hour. With the crayon.
rusty_tom.p13_delirium_1: rusty_tom[alarmed]: Who does he think I am? Don't tell me. I don't want to know.
rusty_tom.p13_channel_1: rusty_tom: The galley set gets it too now. The Channel. Down the cable. I can't get away from it anywhere.
rusty_tom.p13_merch_1: rusty_tom: A Grand Finger-Puller certification card. Blank. Somebody's going to fill that in, Captain. Not me.
rusty_tom.p13_quarters_1: rusty_tom: I'm not going in there. My cold's still very catching. Room-catching.
rusty_tom.p13_song_1: rusty_tom: (humming, then stopping, horrified) I was humming it. I was HUMMING it.
rusty_tom.p13_breakdown_1: rusty_tom[alarmed]: Has he got the finger out? Is the finger out?
barnacle_bill.p13_delirium_1: barnacle_bill: Not an Ancient anything. Just Bill.
barnacle_bill.p13_channel_1: barnacle_bill: Watched it. The Brogath one. He should've asked somebody to hold the sash. Moral of the story.
barnacle_bill.p13_merch_1: barnacle_bill: Got a mug. WORLD'S GRANDEST. Using it for tea.
barnacle_bill.p13_song_1: barnacle_bill: Wardrobe. Sensible. For a song.
barnacle_bill.p13_breakdown_1: barnacle_bill: Five loopholes. All no. Good.
hale.p13_crisis_1: hale: You've got her, Captain. Steady as I've ever seen. Steadier than me.
hale.p13_apocalypse_1: hale: Five degrees port, aye. And I'll report any stomach noises. There haven't been any. I'd tell you.
hale.p13_delirium_1: hale: Who am I, Captain? In the... in your eyes?
hale.p13_channel_1: hale: Can't smell it from up here. I'm staying up here.
hale.p13_merch_1: hale: There's a cable going round my cannon, Captain. I'm just saying. In case anybody wants to fire it.
hale.p13_quarters_1: hale: Something came back over the port rail. Twice. Folded, the second time.
hale.p13_song_1: hale: I heard singing through the hatch. I'm choosing not to ask.
hale.p13_breakdown_1: hale: Quiet morning up here. If you don't count the sharks. I've stopped counting the sharks.
nell.p13: nell: I heard the old quarters are open again. Growling, they said. I'll stay in the hold, thanks.
sully.p13: sully: My horseshoe, Captain. You took my lucky horseshoe for a TELEVISION. No wonder.
fennimore.p13: fennimore: Somebody took the copper coil out of the salvage crate. I was saving that too.
wick.p13: wick: The Channel's on in the galley now. We can hear it down here. It's a lot of narrator.
rook.p13: rook: I heard the captain's seeing things. Ancient things. Don't tell him what I look like.
brask.p13: brask: Another token down the hold hatch: VOTE CAPTAIN BROGATH. I've put it in the bilge.
jory.p13: jory: Is it true, Captain? The baby's still going? On the telly? Since the morning?
finch.p13: finch: The treasure-room door's growling more today. Or I'm listening more. One of the two.
mags.p13: mags: I'm knitting a little cardboard Brogath. Out of wool. It's coming out bashful.
quill.p13: quill: I've started a list of who the captain thinks we all are. It's getting long.
penhallow.p13: penhallow: Nobody's opened the treasure-room door. Three signs on it now. Good.
garrick.p13_crisis_1: garrick: Nine hours, Captain. Then I'm Grand again. Then we can sort all this out.
garrick.p13_crisis_2: garrick: My old fart. In the treasure room. It's almost a pet now. I worry about it.
garrick.p13_treasure_1: garrick[worried]: That growl's familiar, Captain. I just can't place it.
garrick.p13_apocalypse_1: garrick[worried]: Reporting a stomach noise, Captain. Small one. Not a grand one. I'm suspended.
garrick.p13_delirium_1: garrick[worried]: Captain, it's Garrick. Regular Garrick. Suspended. No crown. Look, no crown.
garrick.p13_delirium_2: garrick[worried]: (very still) I'm not moving, Captain. I'm being very still. Like a statue. A regular statue.
garrick.p13_limit_1: garrick[worried]: (perfectly still on the sash cot) ...
garrick.p13_channel_2: garrick[proud]: The Stenchmaster Channel. I always knew there'd be one. I didn't know it would be on a TV I built. With forks.
garrick.p13_merch_1: garrick[delighted]: I have FANS, Captain. Real ones. With mugs.
garrick.p13_merch_2: garrick[businesslike]: Up, round, and down. Like the old masters. Ten feet is no good to anybody.
garrick.p13_bedding_1: garrick[delighted]: (misty) The whole room. In regalia. I didn't even have to ASK.
garrick.p13_quarters_1: garrick[worried]: That was my favourite blanket. Bob's. But I'd been on it.
garrick.p13_song_1: garrick[worried]: Don't throw it in the trash, Captain. I'm not saying that because of the song. I'm saying it because it's MY SASH.
garrick.p13_breakdown_1: garrick[gastro]: (rocking slightly) There must be a LOOPHOLE, Captain. There's always a loophole. I wrote the rules. I'd have put one in.
squawks.p13_delirium_2: squawks[furious]: I am a BIRD. Not a princess. BIRD.
